name: 911 Baked Beans Wild Ride
description: Consolidates a folder of filled NC-calc spreadsheets (the 'NC style baked beans' DSTV/linear-inch pricing sheets) into one review list: DYPN, Total Bevels, Total Complex Bevels, and Total Cut Lin per part, with a grand-total row. Prompts for the folder (the one holding the NC files), plus batch + nest number for the output name, and saves the consolidated list into that same folder. Running the Baked Beans spreadsheet itself is a future stop on the ride.
author: Anthony Sieben
